Trump backs new H-1B visa fee to encourage hiring Americans

Former US President Donald Trump has expressed support for a proposed fee of $103,265 on H-1B visa applications. This fee is intended to encourage companies to hire American workers. The proposed charge would apply to cap-subject applications, including those that qualify for advanced-degree exemptions, in addition to standard immigration costs.
